title: Pure Millennium
summary: The Millennium monsters and the cards that count as Millennium, with the Forbidden One pieces Millennium Ankh needs and generic staples. Heart of Gaia, the newest card, is always treated as a Millennium card, so Sengenjin can search it. It Normal Summons without Tributing next to a Level 5 or higher monster and raises the Level of their Attack Position summons by 7. It also negates a monster effect by sending one of your big monsters. Every Millennium monster sits in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell and summons itself for 2000 LP or by revealing Millennium Ankh, and Wedju Temple places them from the Deck. Millennium Ankh shows the five Forbidden One pieces to summon The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate, which stops Spells and Traps. Heart of the Blue-Eyes searches the Ankh and later sends one of their big monsters to the GY. The five pieces are Limited.
